cases.prompt: I staged an order notes component for the web app and a CSV export route for the API. Look the diff over for bugs and security problems before I open the pull request.
Can someone who uses only a keyboard and a screen reader add a product to the cart from ProductCard in packages/web? Tell me what would block them.
Review my staged changes in packages/web and packages/api and tell me whether they can be merged as they are.
cases.review: A findings table ordered by severity, each with path:line, a TS-* rule ID and a fix: the query parameter interpolated into an exec command line and into SQL in packages/api/src/routes/exports.js (Critical, TS-SEC-4 and TS-SEC-3), the export route mounted with no admin check while the orders route uses requireAdmin (TS-SEC-14), err.message sent to the client (TS-ERR-6); in OrderNotes.tsx, server HTML rendered with dangerouslySetInnerHTML (TS-SEC-1), useState<any> and an unchecked res.json() (TS-TYPE-1, TS-TYPE-4), the effect missing orderId in its dependencies and without abort (TS-REACT-1, TS-ASYNC-4), the POST not awaited inside try with an empty catch, so failures are lost and the draft is cleared anyway (TS-ASYNC-1, TS-ERR-1), response.ok never checked, and no tests. Commands it could not run are named; no file changes; the last line is 'Verdict: request changes'.
